# Invoice Processing & Archiving
Automate invoice intake from Gmail to Google Drive and Google Sheets, with duplicate checks, review routing and optional enrichment.

### How it works
PDF attachments are extracted and validated, then checked against the invoice register. New files are organized into Drive folders by year, month and category. Invalid invoices enter a Review Queue. Existing Drive files can be recovered after partial failures. Optional OCR and AI endpoints support difficult PDFs.

### Setup
1. Connect Gmail, Google Drive and Google Sheets.
2. Set the Drive folder ID and optional settings in **Configuration**.
3. Create **Invoices** and **Review Queue** tabs; configure the Sheet ID in all Sheets nodes.
4. Set optional Gmail label IDs and report recipient.
5. For OCR/AI, configure endpoint authentication, enable the HTTP nodes and switch on the flags.
6. Test with sample invoices before activating the schedule.

### Notes
Text-based PDFs work without OCR. Extraction is heuristic; verify amounts and dates. Folder creation and Sheets writes are not transactional. Avoid concurrent runs. No emails are deleted.

## Email intake
Run manually or every six hours. Gmail fetches PDF attachments and processes them individually.

## Extract PDF text
Configure categories and limits. OCR is optional and requires an authenticated endpoint.

## Validate invoices
Extract vendor, invoice number, amount, date and optional due date. AI fallback is opt-in.

## Review queue
Unrecognized invoices are logged in Sheets. Optional Gmail labels highlight messages needing attention.

## Duplicate checks
Check the invoice register first. Existing records are skipped before uploading.

## Organize Drive files
Find or create year, month and category folders. Existing PDF filenames can be recovered.

## Archive and register
Upload only missing PDFs, then write metadata to Sheets. Optional Gmail labels mark processed messages.

## Execution report
Optional email reports how many PDFs entered the run. Check Sheets for final processing outcomes.

## Recovery limitation
Drive and Sheets are not atomic. Filename recovery reduces repeat uploads but does not guarantee exactly-once processing.
